data.job_description:
This is a role that TechTree is recruiting for on behalf of one of our clients.

TechTree is an AI-driven recruitment platform working with high-growth companies.

When you apply, our AI Agent matches you not just to this role, but to other relevant opportunities across our network, so one application can unlock multiple roles.

About The Role

We're seeking a Senior Frontend Developer to own the frontend of our core product, Sauna. You'll be responsible for shipping interfaces that are instant, intuitive, and polished, even when the underlying work is complex. This role requires making product and design decisions, prototyping quickly, and executing without perfect specs.

What You'll Be Doing

• Own the frontend development of the core product
• Make product and design calls independently
• Prototype and execute designs quickly
• Ensure software feels polished with attention to detail
• Implement and create designs as needed

What We're Looking For

• 4+ years of frontend engineering experience
• Portfolio of complex web apps in production
• Deep fluency in React and state management
• Comfortable with full-stack development
• Strong performance instincts and product sense
• High autonomy and low ego
• US work authorization or O-1 visa eligibility

Nice to Have

• Experience with multiplayer apps and LLM-based tools
• Background in local-first architectures
• Design background or strong visual sense
• Experience as a founding frontend engineer

Compensation & Benefits

• Salary: $180,000 – $240,000
• Meaningful early-stage equity
• Comprehensive health and dental coverage
• 401(k) plan
• Considerable PTO
• Gym budget and daily lunch

About The Company

Our client is a 12–14 person AI-native team based in San Francisco, building a personal AI assistant for knowledge workers. They've raised $30M in seed funding from Spark Capital, Felicis, and Y Combinator, marking one of the largest seed rounds in YC history. The team consists of former founders, CTOs, and high-agency builders, where high ownership is the norm.

What is TechTree?

TechTree combines AI agents with a human support team to give candidates a better, more transparent hiring experience.

Our AI Agent gets to know your background, experience, and what you're optimising for. It continuously matches you to live roles across our network where there's genuine alignment, not just keyword overlap.

Our Human Team is there to support you through the process:

• Answer questions about roles, process, and next steps
• Add context when something in your background isn't obvious
• Help unblock stalled processes or unclear feedback
• Make sure you're not left guessing, ghosted, or wasting time

We only post real jobs. Every role on TechTree is a live, active hire.

If you apply: you'll be considered for this role, you may also be matched to other relevant roles, and if there's no fit, we won't spam you.

DESCRIPTION

Join us in building the future of shopping! If you're passionate about creating unique mobile experiences and want to be part of something revolutionary, we'd love to hear from you. We are seeking exceptional software developers who will help build magical shopping experiences on our iOS application. You will be working on an inter-disciplinary team of highly-capable software engineers (mobile and backend), scientists, designers, and product managers to invent new experiences that work for millions of customers at scale.

Key job responsibilities

• Design and develop high-quality, innovative applications

• Collaborate with cross-functional teams to define, design, and ship new features

• Ensure performance, quality, and responsiveness of applications

• Identify and correct bottlenecks and fix bugs

• Help maintain code quality, organization, and automatization

• Participate in code reviews and contribute to technical discussions

• Write unit tests for robustness, including edge cases, usability, and general reliability

BASIC QUALIFICATIONS

• 5+ years of non-internship professional software development experience

• 5+ years of programming with at least one software programming language experience

• 5+ years of leading design or architecture (design patterns, reliability and scaling) of new and existing systems experience

• Experience as a mentor, tech lead or leading an engineering team

PREFERRED QUALIFICATIONS

• 5+ years of full software development life cycle, including coding standards, code reviews, source control management, build processes, testing, and operations experience

• Bachelor's degree in computer science or equivalent

Amazon is an equal opportunity employer and does not discriminate on the basis of protected veteran status, disability, or other legally protected status.

Los Angeles County applicants: Job duties for this position include: work safely and cooperatively with other employees, supervisors, and staff; adhere to standards of excellence despite stressful conditions; communicate effectively and respectfully with employees, supervisors, and staff to ensure exceptional customer service; and follow all federal, state, and local laws and Company policies. Criminal history may have a direct, adverse, and negative relationship with some of the material job duties of this position. These include the duties and responsibilities listed above, as well as the abilities to adhere to company policies, exercise sound judgment, effectively manage stress and work safely and respectfully with others, exhibit trustworthiness and professionalism, and safeguard business operations and the Company’s reputation. Pursuant to the Los Angeles County Fair Chance Ordinance, we will consider for employment qualified applicants with arrest and conviction records.

Pursuant to the San Francisco Fair Chance Ordinance, we will consider for employment qualified applicants with arrest and conviction records.

If the country/region you’re applying in isn’t listed, please contact your Recruiting Partner.

The base salary range for this position is listed below. Your Amazon package will include sign-on payments and restricted stock units (RSUs). Final compensation will be determined based on factors including experience, qualifications, and location. Amazon also offers comprehensive benefits including health insurance (medical, dental, vision, prescription, Basic Life & AD&D insurance and option for Supplemental life plans, EAP, Mental Health Support, Medical Advice Line, Flexible Spending Accounts, Adoption and Surrogacy Reimbursement coverage), 401(k) matching, paid time off, and parental leave. About Us

At You.com, we are building the AI Search Infrastructure that powers modern AI systems. Our goal is to create the trusted knowledge layer that agents, applications, and enterprises rely on to retrieve real-time, accurate, and citation-backed information.

Our platform combines proprietary vertical indexes with LLM-optimized retrieval systems to power AI agents, applications, and enterprise workflows. We are solving hard problems across search, large language models, and large-scale infrastructure to make AI systems more reliable, transparent, and useful.

Our team includes engineers, researchers, product builders, and operators who care about solving meaningful problems and delivering real-world impact. Whether you are improving core infrastructure, shaping product experiences, or helping bring new AI capabilities to market, your work will help define how modern AI finds and uses knowledge.

About the Role

We are seeking a talented and motivated Front-End Web Developer with a strong background in both design and development. As part of the Marketing team, you will play a key role in creating and maintaining visually stunning, user-friendly, and high-performing websites. This role is perfect for someone who thrives on creativity, values collaboration, and has a passion for combining design aesthetics with technical expertise.

You will collaborate closely with cross-functional teams to deliver high-quality web experiences that align with our brand and business goals. Proficiency in Webflow is critical, as it will be one of your primary tools for design and development.

Responsibilities

• Web Design and Development:

•

• Design and build responsive, visually appealing websites and landing pages using Webflow, HTML, CSS, and JavaScript.

• Collaborate with the Head of Web and Content to develop innovative designs that reflect brand guidelines and engage users.

• Ensure designs and code are optimized for performance, accessibility, and cross-browser compatibility.

• Content Updates and Maintenance:

•

• Maintain and update existing websites, ensuring they remain modern, functional, and error-free.

• Implement content updates in collaboration with the content team, ensuring consistency and brand alignment.

• User Experience (UX) and Optimization:

•

• Work closely with stakeholders to understand user needs and translate them into intuitive web experiences.

• Conduct regular reviews and testing to optimize website performance and usability.

• Coding and Customization:

•

• Write clean, scalable, and maintainable code for custom Webflow components or integrations when necessary.

• Collaborate with back-end developers when required to implement advanced functionality.

• Collaboration and Communication:

•

• Work alongside the content, marketing, and design teams to ensure web projects meet deadlines and objectives.

• Stay up-to-date with the latest front-end trends, tools, and technologies to continuously improve web development practices.

Qualifications

•

• 1-3 years of experience in front-end web development or a related field.

• Proven experience designing and building websites in Webflow is required.

• Proficiency in Webflow, HTML, CSS, and JavaScript, and Figma.

• Familiarity with responsive design principles and best practices.

• Basic understanding of SEO principles and website performance optimization.

• Experience with version control systems like Git is a plus.

• A strong eye for design with the ability to create visually compelling, user-focused web layouts.

• Experience with design tools such as Adobe XD, MarkUp, or Sketch is an advantage.

• Strong communication and collaboration skills.

• Detail-oriented with excellent problem-solving and time management abilities.

• Eagerness to learn and adapt to new tools and technologies.

Our salary bands are structured based on a combination of geographic tiers and internal leveling. Compensation is determined by multiple factors assessed during the interview process, with the final offer reflecting these considerations.

Salary Band

$130,000 - $175,000 USD

Company Perks:

•
Hubs in San Francisco and New York City offering regular in-person gatherings and co-working sessions

•
Flexible PTO with U.S. holidays observed and a week shutdown in December to rest and recharge*

•
A competitive health insurance plan covers 100% of the policyholder and 75% for dependents*

•
12 weeks of paid parental leave in the US*

•
401k program, 3% match - vested immediately!*

•
$500 work-from-home stipend to be used up to a year of your start date*

• $600 technology stipend to support a portion of our hybrid/remote team's cell phone and internet expenses*

•
$1,200 per year Health & Wellness Allowance to support your personal goals*

•
The chance to collaborate with a team at the forefront of AI research

• Certain perks and benefits are limited to full-time employees only

At FurtherAI, we're creating vertical AI agents, to automate tasks traditionally done by humans. We recently raised a seed round from top investors (announcement soon), growing rapidly, and are looking for superstars to join us on our journey.

We feel most B2B softwares suck and it doesn’t have to be that way. As a frontend engineer, you'll play a pivotal role in building the core product while also spearheading efforts to optimize performance and continuously improve the product to make it AI-native.

This is an in-person role based in San Francisco.

Qualifications

• 3+ years of experience in building products in the 0 to 1 stage
• Experience building frontend systems in React
• Ability to communicate well, both in person and on paper
• Previous work at a B2B SaaS company is a bonus
• Insane drive and ownership - If you are world-class here, other requirements are optional

What we value

At FurtherAI, we take immense pride in our work, operate with a strong sense of ownership, and are relentless in our pursuit of excellence. Every member of our team works extremely hard, driven by the common goal of building something transformative. If you’re not ready to bring this level of commitment and ownership to the table, this role may not be the right fit for you.

Perfect opportunity if you want to

• Build AI-first product experiences
• Own a significant part of the frontend stack
• Be one of the first employees in a fast-paced startup
• Shape our culture
• Start your own company in future (~70% of our company is ex-founders!)

About Engenious

Engenious is a technology company building next-generation AI products that transform how people work, learn, and create.

We partner with fast-growing startups and global companies to design and scale intelligent systems - from AI-powered applications to full-stack platforms used by millions.

Our team combines deep engineering expertise with product thinking to deliver solutions that are not just technically strong, but genuinely useful.

About the Role

We're looking for a Frontend Engineer to join our team and work on AI-driven products.

In this role, you will be working as part of an Engenious team embedded with one of our clients, a leading technology company building products used at global scale. You'll collaborate closely with both Engenious and client-side teams to deliver high-impact solutions.

You'll help build systems that support students throughout their writing journey - from drafting and citations to AI transparency and plagiarism detection.

This role combines frontend development with practical application of modern AI technologies, and you'll be expected to actively work with AI-powered features as part of your day-to-day development.

What You'll Do
• Contribute to end-to-end feature delivery on the frontend, ensuring high-quality user experiences in production.
• Develop clean, intuitive user interfaces
• Build and integrate AI-powered features into product workflows
• Work with LLM-based systems and AI-driven services
• Improve performance, reliability, and system architecture
• Collaborate with product, design, and AI teams (both Engenious and client-side)
• Contribute to technical decisions and engineering standards
• Mentor engineers and support team growth

What You'll Work On
• AI-powered writing and productivity tools
• Systems for AI transparency and authorship clarity
• Citation and attribution workflows
• Plagiarism and AI-usage detection
• Integrations with educational platforms and tools

Requirements
• 4+ years of experience in frontend development
• Proficiency with modern web technologies, including React.js, Next.js, Vite, and Nx )
• Proficiency with Typescript is a must
• Strong fundamentals in algorithms and system design
• Experience building and scaling production systems
• Experience debugging complex systems
• Strong product mindset and attention to user experience
• Experience working within cross-team collaboration responsible for high-load production systems, including services serving 100,000+ users or operating at significant request-per-second scale.

Must be legally authorized to work in the United States at the time of hire; we are unable to provide visa sponsorship for this role

Nice to Have
• Backend development experience with Java would be a big plus

Full-Time Conversion (Future Opportunity)

About Air Apps

At Air Apps, we believe in thinking bigger—and moving faster. We’re a family-founded company on a mission to create the world’s first AI-powered Personal & Entrepreneurial Resource Planner (PRP), and we need your passion and ambition to help us change how people plan, work, and live. Born in Lisbon, Portugal, in 2018—and now with offices in both Lisbon and San Francisco—we’ve remained self-funded while reaching over 100 million downloads worldwide.

Our long-term focus drives us to challenge the status quo every day, pushing the boundaries of AI-driven solutions that truly make a difference. Here, you’ll be a creative force, shaping products that empower people across the globe.

Join us on this journey to redefine resource management—and change lives along the way.

The Role

As a Front-End Web Developer at Air Apps, you will be responsible for crafting seamless, high-performance, and visually engaging web experiences. You will work closely with designers, product managers, and back-end developers to build and optimize user interfaces using modern web technologies. Your work will directly impact millions of users, ensuring intuitive and efficient interactions with our AI-powered platform.

Responsibilities

•
Develop and maintain responsive, user-friendly web applications using HTML, CSS, and JavaScript frameworks such as React, Vue, or Angular.

•
Collaborate with UI/UX designers to translate design concepts into interactive and accessible web interfaces.

•
Optimize applications for performance, scalability, and cross-browser compatibility.

•
Implement reusable components and maintainable front-end architectures.

•
Work closely with back-end developers to integrate APIs and ensure seamless data flow.

•
Stay up-to-date with emerging front-end technologies, trends, and best practices.

•
Debug and resolve front-end issues to ensure a smooth user experience.

Requirements

•
Around 3+ years of experience in front-end web development.

•
Proficiency in HTML, CSS, JavaScript, and modern frameworks such as React, Vue, or Angular.

•
Experience with state management libraries (e.g., Redux, Vuex, or Zustand).

•
Strong understanding of responsive design, accessibility, and cross-browser compatibility.

•
Knowledge of CSS pre-processors (SASS, LESS) and front-end build tools (Webpack, Vite).

•
Familiarity with RESTful APIs, GraphQL, and front-end performance optimization techniques.

•
Experience with version control systems like Git.

•
Strong problem-solving skills and attention to detail.

•
Ability to work in an agile environment and collaborate effectively with cross-functional teams.

What benefits do we offer?

•
Apple hardware ecosystem for work.

•
Annual Bonus.

•
Medical Insurance (including vision & dental).

•
Disability insurance - short and long-term.

•
401k up to 4% contribution.

•
Air Conference – an opportunity to meet the team, collaborate, and grow together.

•
Transportation budget

•
Free meals at the hub

•
Gym membership

Diversity & Inclusion

At Air Apps, we are committed to fostering a diverse, inclusive, and equitable workplace. We enthusiastically welcome applicants from all backgrounds, experiences, and perspectives. We celebrate diversity in all its forms and believe that varied voices and experiences make us stronger.

Application Disclaimer

At Air Apps, we value transparency and integrity in our hiring process. Applicants must submit their own work without any AI-generated assistance. Any use of AI in application materials, assessments, or interviews will result in disqualification.

Compensation Range: $99K - $170K

About Aidaly

At Aidaly, we believe family caregivers are the future of healthcare and the backbone of a thriving economy. In-home care is the fastest-growing part of healthcare, but demand is outpacing supply. We are pioneering a new model for delivering care at home by training and paying family caregivers to meet the needs of an evolving population and changing workforce. We are scaling rapidly across the United States. Join us!
What You'll Do
• Build Aidaly’s internal Admin OS tools and user-facing product.
• Develop intuitive, efficient tools that enable operations, clinical, and revenue teams.
• Optimize interfaces for performance, usability, and accessibility.
• Collaborate with backend engineers and product managers.

RequirementsWho You Are
• 3–5 years frontend development experience.
• Strong expertise in React, TypeScript, and component-driven design.
• Experience building dashboards, internal tools, or enterprise software.
• Strong no-code utilization and API-interface deployment.
• Detail-oriented and user-experience obsessed.

If you're the type of person people naturally depend on for support; honest, consistent, calm under pressure, and solution-focused - WE WANT YOU!

BenefitsWhat We Offer
• Competitive salary + performance bonuses based on KPIs.
• Health, dental, and vision insurance.
• Paid time off and holidays.
• 401K (starting Q3 2025)
• High-autonomy, high-impact role — true domain ownership.
• Quarterly off-sites, trainings, and team building experiences.
• Opportunity to build something transformative for millions of American families.

About Halliday

Halliday is a blockchain company and product lab working to create a unified, cross-chain payments ecosystem. Its flagship product, Halliday Payments, is a unified payments platform that makes it easy for users to onramp, swap, and take other onchain actions. Halliday’s products are built on the Workflow Protocol, which removes the need to code smart contracts by hand and enables breakthrough applications to ship in hours, not years.

Backed by a16z and #Hashed, Halliday has worked with prominent developers such as ApeChain, Story Protocol and DeFi Kingdoms to provide seamless experiences for both developers and users. The team includes alumni from Stanford, Harvard, Compound, Meta, Netflix, and more.

About the role

As a Frontend Engineer at Halliday, you'll build the user-facing products that power the future of blockchain payments. You'll design and implement intuitive, high-performance interfaces that make onchain transactions seamless for millions of users. This is an opportunity to work on cutting-edge technology with a talented team that's redefining how people interact with blockchain.

What you'll be doing

Build User-Facing Products: Design and develop responsive, performant frontend applications using React and TypeScript that interact with blockchain networks, payment systems, and DeFi protocols while delivering an exceptional user experience.

Develop Core Infrastructure: Build scalable components, design systems, and testing frameworks that support our payments platform and developer tools.

Ship Developer Tools: Contribute to Halliday's public SDKs and APIs, making it easy for developers to integrate blockchain payments into their applications.

Work Cross-Functionally: Collaborate with product, design, engineering, and partnerships teams to deliver features that solve real user problems and drive product adoption.

Drive Technical Excellence: Identify and implement improvements to enhance performance, accessibility, security, and code quality across our frontend stack.

Innovate on Web3 UX: Push the boundaries of what's possible in blockchain user experiences, making complex onchain actions feel simple and intuitive.

What we’re looking for

Frontend Expertise: 2+ years of experience building production frontend applications with React and TypeScript. You write clean, maintainable code and care deeply about user experience.

Technical Proficiency: Strong understanding of modern frontend development including state management, API integration, responsive design, and performance optimization.

Product Mindset: You think beyond just implementing features, you understand the "why" behind what you're building and advocate for the best user experience.

Fast Learner: You're excited to dive into new technologies, whether that's blockchain SDKs, payment APIs, or emerging web standards.

Collaborative Spirit: You work well with cross-functional teams, communicate effectively, and thrive in a fast-paced startup environment.

Location: Based in or willing to relocate to the San Francisco Bay Area or New York City.

Nice to haves

Blockchain Experience: Previous work with blockchain technologies such as EVM-based chains, Solana, or Bitcoin. Familiarity with Web3 libraries like ethers.js, viem, or wagmi.

Payments Background: Experience building payment flows, checkout experiences, or financial products.

Full-Stack Capabilities: Comfort working across the stack when needed, including APIs and backend services.

Design Sensibility: Strong eye for design and experience working closely with designers to implement pixel-perfect interfaces.

Open Source Contributions: Active participation in open source projects or maintenance of public libraries.

Why Work at Halliday?

A role with significant autonomy to build out the next generation infrastructure of the blockchain space.

Competitive compensation package, with unlimited PTO and a friendly work environment.

For international candidates - we offer visa sponsorship!

Compensation

The base salary range for this role is $150,000 - $190,000. This reflects the minimum and maximum range across all US locations. This does not include equity or benefits.

The actual base pay is dependent upon many factors, such as: experience, relevant skills, and role level. Your recruiter can share more about the compensation and benefits applicable to your location during the hiring process.
